mainEntity.name: How much does an Audi A4 Allroad 45 TFSI / TDI engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on the condition of the replacement unit and the specific engine code. Based on verified market data, used engines typically range from £800 to £2,500, while reconditioned units cost between £2,000 and £4,500.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of water pump failure in an Audi A4 Allroad 45 TFSI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water pump and thermostat housing failure in the 45 TFSI often presents as a gradual loss of coolant without obvious external leaks, as the plastic housing cracks internally.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in an Audi A4 Allroad 45 TDI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, given that B9 and B9.5 Allroad models typically hold a market value of £14,000 to £32,000, a full rebuilt or reconditioned engine replacement is financially viable.

mainEntity.name: How long does an Audi A4 Allroad 45 TFSI / TDI engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A straightforward supply and fit service for this variant typically takes between 2 to 4 working days, depending on the specialist's workload and the complexity of the quattro drivetrain calibration.

mainEntity.name: Will a replacement engine affect my Audi A4 Allroad's warranty or resale value?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professionally installed, OEM-spec replacement engine with documented service history and a valid warranty will preserve, and in some cases enhance, your vehicle's resale value.

historyTimeline.h2: Audi A4 Allroad 45 TFSI / TDI - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: When the "45" badging was introduced for the A4 Allroad (B9 generation), it signified the high-output 2.0-litre turbocharged petrol (TFSI) and diesel (TDI) variants, replacing the previous numeric horsepower designations. Over its production run, these engines received mild-hybrid integration and emissions refinements while maintaining robust performance.

milestones.description: B9 generation launch. 45 TFSI introduced with the CYRB (252hp) EA888 Gen 3 engine. 45 TDI introduced with the CNHA (190hp) EA288 engine.
B9.5 facelift. 45 TFSI updated to DKZA/DKNB (245-265hp) with 12V mild-hybrid integration. 45 TDI updated to DEUA/DETA (204hp) with refined AdBlue systems and improved efficiency.

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the Audi A4 Allroad 45 TFSI / TDI is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: Audi A4 Allroad 45 TFSI / TDI Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Audi A4 Allroad 45 TFSI / TDI variants are generally robust, but specific components carry known vulnerabilities. The CYRB (TFSI) and CNHA/DEUA (TDI) codes dominate replacement demand for this variant due to cooling system weaknesses and emissions component failures. Rebuilt engines sourced through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these original failure points, backed by a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Water Pump & Thermostat Housing Failure - Why the Audi A4 Allroad 45 TFSI / TDI (CYRB) Loses Coolant
problems.affectedModels: Audi A4 Allroad 45 TFSI / TDI (CYRB, DKZA, DKNB, 2016-present)
problems.rootCause: Plastic components within the integrated water pump and thermostat housing warp and crack under sustained heat cycles, leading to gradual coolant loss and potential overheating if ignored.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replacement of water pump and thermostat housing assembly
repairOptions.longevity: Highly recommended as preventative maintenance at 80k miles

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded cooling components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Necessary only if coolant loss has caused catastrophic overheating and cylinder head damage

problems.recommendation: For the 45 TFSI, preventative replacement of the water pump and thermostat housing is highly advised before catastrophic failure occurs. For the 45 TDI, a reconditioned engine is a strong investment given the high retained value of the Allroad chassis, but ensure the specialist verifies the AdBlue and DPF systems are fully functional to prevent repeat issues.

problems.h4: AdBlue System & DPF Clogging - Why the Audi A4 Allroad 45 TFSI / TDI (TDI) Enters Limp Mode
problems.affectedModels: Audi A4 Allroad 45 TFSI / TDI (CNHA, DEUA, DETA, 2016-present)
problems.rootCause: Frequent short urban journeys prevent active DPF regeneration, while AdBlue heater or NOx sensor failures trigger emissions-related limp mode, restricting engine performance.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: AdBlue heater/sensor replacement and forced DPF regeneration
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if the engine block and turbo remain in good health

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, rebuilt unit with updated emissions components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Recommended if DPF blockage has caused turbo contamination or severe engine damage
